Algorithms for solving the traffic assignment problem are All-or-Nothing assignment, Method of Successive Averages, Frank-Wolfe algorithm (M. Fukushima (1984) <doi:10.1016/0191-2615(84)90029-8>), Conjugate and Bi-Conjugate Frank-Wolfe algorithms (M. Mitradjieva, P. O. Lindberg (2012) <doi:10.1287/trsc.1120.0409>), Algorithm-B (R. B.
